I've tried various drivers in RPM Fusion and Fedora's regular packages pertaining to Broadcom to no avail.
Anyone have experience with getting a Broadcom BCM43526 Wireless NIC working in Fedora Workstaion 24 ?

I've had the same issues with anything wireless-n from Broadcom, on pretty much any distro. You'll find that the most common suggestion is to dump it and pick up a cheap wireless usb dongle. They actually work great. Alternatively, you can look into a powerline adapter kit, if you don't need the mobility offered by wireless, and are just looking for an easy way to expand your network -- they've gotten way better over the past couple of years, and have pretty respectable throughput.

No, but I have a drawer with several Broadcom wireless dongles when I migrated several desktops to Linux. None worked. This is a proprietary driver issue. Just buy a sub $10 dongle and it will likely work just fine. I haven't found a cheap one that didn't.
